verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Lord, make us ready now to share this meal
Sign of our life in you

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
We bring you this food
Which bears the stain of human toil

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines: This bread, hard worn food of slavery

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
This bread which brings to mind each meal
Which men have shared in happiness

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines: Lord give it power to make us free

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
We bring you this wine
The fruit of distant smoky hills

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines: This wine, cool and red like evening light

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
The cause of suffering yet the drink
That makes man's heart alive and warm

verse.name: v2d
verse.lines: Lord, give it power to make us free
